input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including refresh token, user, role. The platform provides capabilities for refresh token, user details, user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage refresh token records, so that I can track and organize refresh token data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with test functionality, so that I can accomplish my test-related tasks.
